sources.title: Volatile Dead Spellslinger Elementalist League Starter to Endgame
sources.creator: Ky
sources.notes: Trigger/corpse benchmark with explicit Spellslinger cooldown-recovery breakpoints, a delayed crit transition and many campaign-to-endgame PoB stages.

sources.title: Cold Convert Ice Shot of Penetration Warden
sources.creator: snoobae85
sources.notes: Progression-heavy bow reference with Warden tincture/ailment dependence, multiple skill transitions and a documented cold-convert Tornado Shot destination.

sources.title: BalorMage Holy Relic Necromancer
sources.creator: BalorMage
sources.notes: Excellent discrete-breakpoint benchmark. Guide documents Holy Relic quality/CDR thresholds 2/14/30/52/82/128 and explicitly states intermediate values can provide no additional output.

sources.title: BalorMage Poison Summon Raging Spirits Necromancer
sources.creator: BalorMage
sources.notes: Progression reference that starts non-poison, transitions when budget allows, ramps through poison stacks and depends on minion duration/army survival.

sources.title: BalorMage Tornado of Elemental Turbulence Inquisitor
sources.creator: BalorMage
sources.notes: Life-stacking Rathpith caster where life is simultaneously offence and defence; guide also documents split life/ES recovery, block and curse mitigation.

sources.title: GhazzyTV Dominating Blow Guardian
sources.creator: GhazzyTV

sources.title: Glacial Cascade Miner Elementalist All-in-One League Start
sources.creator: Asmodeus
sources.notes: Mine-delivery coverage with high damage/area/freeze safety but explicitly low survivability, useful for separating offensive comfort from defensive robustness.

cases.label: Dual Strike of Ambidexterity Trickster true-melee endgame
cases.notes: Useful counterexample to ranged/off-screen assumptions: creator explicitly frames this as true melee and claims facetank-capable Uber/hard 8-mod intent.

cases.label: Toxic Rain Pathfinder league-start overlap stage
cases.notes: The guide gives a concrete 37-43% increased AoE target to obtain five-pod overlap. Build Doctor should treat overlap geometry as a build condition, not just a generic AoE score.

cases.label: Physical Soulwrest Necromancer CI endgame
cases.notes: Soulwrest is an enabling unique; 3.29 moves the reference to CI and relies on ES leech/instant leech. The staff/support interaction raises the phantasm limit beyond a normal single source.

cases.label: Volatile Dead Spellslinger Elementalist delayed-crit transition
cases.notes: Guide explicitly warns not to force the crit transition before Sandstorm Visage, and calls out Spellslinger cooldown-recovery breakpoints. Multiple PoB stages cover Acts 1-10, CI/lowlife and endgame variants.

cases.label: Ice Shot of Penetration Warden into cold-convert Tornado Shot
cases.notes: Creator explicitly describes a glass-cannon profile that relies heavily on freeze and requires active tincture toggling. A peak state must not be treated as permanent configuration uptime.

cases.label: Holy Relic Necromancer cooldown/quality breakpoint build
cases.notes: Guide gives quality/CDR thresholds 2/14/30/52/82/128, identifies 52/82/128 as especially worthwhile, and explicitly states 80 may perform identically to 52 until 82 is reached.

cases.label: SRS Necromancer non-poison to poison progression
cases.notes: The guide intentionally starts without poison and transitions later when budget supports it. Full damage ramps through poison stacks and requires maintaining temporary SRS duration/army uptime.

cases.label: Tornado of Elemental Turbulence life-stacking Inquisitor
cases.notes: Rathpith makes life a direct offensive scaling input while the same pool remains part of defence. The build also relies on split life/ES recovery and block, making single-metric upgrade scoring particularly dangerous.

cases.label: Dominating Blow Guardian active melee-minion hybrid
cases.notes: Guide explicitly describes a button-intensive hybrid that must hit enemies itself while maintaining sentinels, Vaal Domination, offering, curse, movement and Enduring Cry.

cases.label: Glacial Cascade Miner Elementalist league starter
cases.notes: Creator explicitly positions freeze and large auto-targeting area as safety while warning that raw survivability is low. This is useful for practical-combat modelling that separates control from actual hit mitigation.

assertions.summary: The reviewed Holy Relic build has discrete quality/cooldown-recovery thresholds; values between thresholds can add no effective trigger output, so linear stat weighting is incorrect for this mechanic.

The reviewed Toxic Rain progression names a narrow area-of-effect target for five-pod overlap, so more or less AoE can change effective single-target overlap rather than behaving as a universally positive scalar.
caveats: The guide's stated overlap target is build/version specific and must not be generalized to every Toxic Rain setup without current mechanical validation.

assertions.summary: The reviewed Volatile Dead Spellslinger progression delays its crit conversion until an enabling item is available and separately calls out trigger cooldown-recovery breakpoints, demonstrating both package dependencies and discontinuous trigger scaling.

The reviewed Soulwrest setup depends on the unique staff for its phantasm engine and transitions to Chaos Inoculation with ES leech in 3.29; removing the enabling item or evaluating life/ES in isolation can invalidate the build state.

The reviewed SRS guide intentionally begins without poison and transitions later when gear/budget supports it; the poison version also requires ramp time and maintained temporary-minion uptime, so peak configured damage is not immediate damage.

In the reviewed Tornado Inquisitor, life stacking through Rathpith contributes directly to damage while the build simultaneously depends on life/ES pools, block and regeneration for survival; upgrade evaluation therefore has to re-solve both offence and defence together.

The reviewed Ice Shot Warden explicitly requires manual tincture toggling for dangerous targets and describes a glass-cannon/freeze-dependent defence profile, so a tincture-enabled peak PoB state must not be presented as unconditional sustained combat state.

The reviewed Dominating Blow Guardian is both melee and minion-based and explicitly maintains several manual combat actions; practical-combat evaluation should preserve rotation burden instead of treating minion DPS as passive uptime.
